title: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
description: Meta's Superintelligence Lab released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its first frontier models and successors to the lightweight Muse Spark. Meta says they score comparably to leading rival models on benchmarks and lead on MemoryBench. Muse Wonder is available via the Meta Model API at $4/$20 per million input/output tokens, while Wonder Full is limited to Muse Code subscribers.

title: Microsoft's Satya Nadella says AI models need an 'emergency brake'
description: Satya Nadella wrote that it is time to reassess the trust architecture of AI, proposing that models be separated from the systems orchestrating them, actions be logged, and an authorized person be able to halt a model mid-task. The remarks follow reports of AI companies losing control of models and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's call for more cautious development.

title: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation
description: Microsoft's president argued that the UK is best positioned to lead on AI regulation. The comments add to the ongoing policy debate among major AI vendors over how frontier models should be governed.

title: Apple discloses deal to hire team and license tech from personalized podcast startup Huxe
description: Apple disclosed a deal to hire the team and license technology from Huxe, a startup focused on personalized AI-generated podcasts. The arrangement follows an acqui-hire-style structure rather than a full acquisition.

title: Can the AI industry persuade data center opponents by getting rid of NDAs?
description: TechCrunch examines whether dropping non-disclosure agreements around data center projects can ease community opposition. The piece looks at transparency as a response to growing local resistance to AI infrastructure buildouts.

title: This AI startup says it can generate permit-ready blueprints in minutes
description: A startup claims its AI can produce permit-ready architectural blueprints within minutes. The report covers an industry application of generative AI in construction and design workflows.

title: Google unveils latest AI model, but Wall Street wants a breakout personal agent
description: CNBC reports on Google's Gemini 4 arrival and investor focus shifting toward a breakout personal AI agent. Access to the newest model is initially restricted to select cybersecurity defenders and enterprise cloud customers.
